input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 addresses only access cut-off, Deliverable delivery and refunds; it refers to "any agreed transition period" without creating one or setting a duration. No clause requires return or export of Customer Data: Section 16.5 expressly carves Customer Data out of the confidential-information return/destroy duty and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15", but Section 11 does not exist in the Agreement and Section 15 imposes only processing restrictions. In a hosted services agreement this fails the fallback on every element, so we insert a single short exit clause at the fallback level (90 days' transition assistance; Customer Data export within 30 days of expiry or termination) rather than the longer preferred package.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert exit clause in Section 10: 90 days of transition assistance and Customer Data export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provision (Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to a Section 11 that does not exist), so we added a short clause giving us at least ninety days of transition assistance and export of our Customer Data within thirty days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback position; we can discuss the preferred six-month assistance and certified deletion package if you prefer.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form, Vendor shall provide transition assistance for at least ninety days and shall export all Customer Data to Customer within thirty days.
